name: statusline
description: Tiny composable statusline CLI for AI coding agents: pre-built segments (machine name, project + branch, model, context remaining, session cost) rendered as one or more status-bar rows. Ships the `statusline` CLI, a stdio `statusline-mcp` server, and the package SDK (render/format/segment functions exported from the package root). The only persistent state is a user-editable JSON config at $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/statusline/config.json; there is no database and no HTTP server surface.

waivedSurfaces.reason: The statusline-mcp stdio server ships in package.json bin, but the kit 0.11.1 class taxonomy admits no truthful declaration for it: class library forbids -mcp bins and class cli-with-store requires a storage block (sqlite/postgresql) while this app has no database of any kind. The mcp surface is therefore waived with its bin undeclared until the app gains a store or the taxonomy gains a config-file store class.
No HTTP server surface ships: package.json declares no -serve bin and no source file starts an HTTP listener.

conformance.notes: storage is deliberately absent. The package has no database backend: the only persistent state is a JSON config file at $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/statusline/config.json (config.ts) plus read-only access to the Claude accounts state file. storage.backend admits sqlite | postgresql only, and neither engine is used.
